note: OPTIONAL wide UK search APIs. Do not commit credentials. Copy selected entries to local_config/sources.json (merge with defaults). Reed uses REED_API_KEY; Adzuna uses ADZUNA_APP_ID and ADZUNA_APP_KEY. Review commercial reuse terms. Blank query requests broad recent listings; searches are capped for safe API usage. For the persistent refresh command, set permission_status to personal_use_reviewed, licensed or employer_permission only after the corresponding rights review. enabled=true alone does not grant permission.
